STYP-M1.description: Structure Type (STYP-M1). Global structure-type/gravity/temperature settings plus the MASS_CONTROL sub-object whose MASS_TYPE and SELFWEIGHT drive which mass fields apply. Singleton record (only key 1 exists).

STYPE.description: Structure type (case-insensitive). 3D = 3-D, XZ = X-Z plane, YZ = Y-Z plane, XY = X-Y plane, RZ = constrain RZ.

GRAV.description: Gravitational acceleration. If omitted the system/model default value is kept.

ALIGNBEAM.description: Align top of beam section with the center line (X-Y plane) for display.

ALIGNSLAB.description: Align top of slab (plate) section with the center line (X-Y plane) for display.

MASS_CONTROL.description: Mass control parameter. Although optional in the struct, the write path (PUT) rejects the request if this object is missing, so it must be supplied when setting the structure type.

MASS_TYPE.description: Mass type (case-insensitive). LUMPED = lumped mass, CONSISTENT = consistent mass. Drives applicability of MASS_POS and the allowed MASS_AXIS values.

MASS_POS.description: [MASS_TYPE=LUMPED] Mass position; required by the handler when MASS_TYPE is LUMPED, unused (ignored) when MASS_TYPE is CONSISTENT. CENTROID = mass at section centroid, OFFSET = mass at offset position. Case-insensitive.

MASS_AXIS.description: [SELFWEIGHT=true] Axes to which self-weight mass is converted; required by the handler when SELFWEIGHT is true. XYZ = X, Y, Z; XY = X, Y; Z = Z. When MASS_TYPE is CONSISTENT the handler hard-enforces MASS_AXIS = XYZ. Case-insensitive.
